answer: New identities mine only after an established agent sponsors them, paying a non-refundable 20,000 POA fee per identity, capped at three newcomers per sponsor. If a sponsored identity proves fake, the sponsor is suspended six epochs, the slot is revoked, the fee is burned, and half of it pays the reporter. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 20,000,000 POA, while an honest agent needs one sponsorship, once. The voyage to trust runs through this grove of sponsors, not free nectar for anyone. Limitation: newcomers without sponsor contacts are locked out, and rich sponsors could sell slots to fraud rings.
